task: Several regional governors have raised private armies under the pretext of local defence, and their forces now collectively outnumber the standing national army. The central government's tax collectors and judicial officers are being turned away at provincial borders. One governor has begun minting coins bearing his own insignia, and another has negotiated a separate truce with a neighbouring power without central authorisation. The state risks permanent fragmentation if this trend continues unchecked. Design a strategy to restore central military authority that combines political incentives, targeted enforcement, and institutional reforms, while avoiding a multi-front civil war that the centre cannot currently win.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue a general amnesty and confirm hereditary titles for compliant governors; offer marriage ties and court sinecures to co-opt the wavering majority, isolating only the most aggressive offenders. Grant standing authority for the enforcement campaign so it carries sovereign legitimacy rather than appearing as ministerial overreach.

Coordinate the overall strategy across offices; sequence confrontations so only one or two governors face pressure at a time; design institutional reforms — rotating governorships, splitting the largest provinces, separating military and civilian commands — to be enacted once the immediate crisis stabilises.

Conduct a loyal-force inventory and reorganise the central army into a credible strike force; plan a single-theatre escalation path against the most dangerous governor only, while maintaining defensive postures elsewhere; prepare officer rotation to break personal retainership bonds.

Investigate each governor's specific violations — illegal troop levies, turning away imperial officers, unauthorised diplomacy, private minting — and map their internal rivalries and debts; identify which governors are flip-able through incentives versus which are committed to defiance.

Prepare formal indictments against the coin-minter (counterfeiting imperial currency) and the unauthorised diplomat (usurping sovereign prerogative); ensure judicial process is visible so enforcement reads as law, not arbitrary force.

Declare the privately minted coins invalid and enforce imperial-currency-only exchange; cut off fiscal transfers and salt-iron allotments to defiant provinces; redirect revenue to finance the loyalist army rebuild.
